rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Part II amounts print the writer's official text (1,234.56) in single text cells; Item 12 splits into the peso comb and the 2-slot cents comb around the printed decimal. Values the sheet prints differently from the submitted controls (the address over two comb lines, Items 11A-13 blank when Item 11 is No) come from derived: keys of to_print_field_map, never the XML. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option.
